get_current_robot_info: get the current robot info including job id, work unit, operator id, and operational status from the orchestrator
set_current_robot_operator_id: set the current operator ID for a robot by calling the orchestrator server with the robot id
update_robot_hardware_config: update the robot hardware configuration by merging a list of hardware components with the orchestrator
disconnect_orchestrator: disconnect the OrchestratorCurrentRobotInfo client from the orchestrator server by clearing the active connection
init_orchestrator_current_robot_info: initialize an OrchestratorCurrentRobotInfo client with a discovery resource connection, robot id, and optional hostname
